headline: Executive order sets up a presidential advisory committee focused on illnesses reported by veterans of the 1991 Gulf War.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a committee to advise the President on illnesses affecting Gulf War veterans. Committees like this usually review research and government efforts and then make recommendations. No summary was provided, so details such as the committee's members, exact duties, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who served in the 1991 Persian Gulf War
who_it_affects.how: Their reported illnesses are the subject the new advisory committee is set up to look into.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle veterans' health and military affairs
who_it_affects.how: They may be asked to provide information to the committee or respond to its advice.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on May 26, 1995, as is typical for executive orders.
